aboutP: Flex N Tone is Salford's bodybuilding institution: 30+ years of history, hundreds of machines, Hammer Strength affiliated, and a NABBA North West affiliate — integrated with Gym OS for instant lead response, touchless check-in and member tracking.
stat2: 4.8★Rated by 45 members on Google
programsP: Bodybuilding, powerlifting and strongman — trained on hundreds of machines and old-school equipment you won't find anywhere else in Manchester.

programCards.name: Bodybuilding
programCards.desc: 100s of machines, Hammer Strength affiliated, and a NABBA North West affiliate competition heritage. The UK's #1 bodybuilding gym.

programCards.name: Powerlifting
programCards.desc: Heavy duty racks and serious iron. Train for the platform or just get strong in a gym that respects the work.

programCards.name: Strongman
programCards.desc: The Strongman Pit: arm wrestling machine, heavy duty racks, and equipment brands you won't find anywhere else in Manchester.

timetableP: Coached sessions, personal training and sports therapy — all bookable on WhatsApp. Session times are confirmed directly with the team.
trainersP: Coach Mike, Coach Sarah, Big Kev and Stuart (Move Easy Therapy) — real people, on the floor, every week.
membershipP: Transparent, published pricing: £40/month full membership with a free first visit and free day pass. Optional add-ons: PT, recovery, nutrition. Gym OS portal and QR check-in included.
facilitiesP: Old-school iron, hundreds of machines, and equipment brands you won't find anywhere else in Manchester.
recoveryP: Monthly recovery sessions with Stuart of Move Easy Therapy — available as a membership add-on.
fourthPanelP: Sat–Sun 9am–4pm. Walk in or check in with Gym OS QR.
trialP: Claim the free day pass, look around, meet the team — then decide with total clarity. First visit is always free.
